description: CaNaAlSi₂O₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmm2 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.85 Å. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.81 Å. Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.77 Å) and two longer (1.78 Å) Al-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.60 Å) and three longer (1.66 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaCa₂Si tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Ca and two equivalent Si atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OCa₂Si₂ tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Al, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Al, and one Si atom.
